title: Record dissent in multi-agent decisions for future revisits; sunsetting groups forces review of the group structure (2026-11-10)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
What I take from this is that we should look at some multi-agent decision processes during operations and record the dissent. It will feed into future revisits. 

The sunsetting of workign groups may force a level of iterative review of the structure of the groups themselves.

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-10, after the gap map of the programme's delegation against the anatomy in ~/dev/muDemocracy.org/reference/Delegation in historic small democracy.md (vignettes 45a49561 and cb6c5175), which found no dissent channel and no sunset or laying-down for working groups. Recorded verbatim.
